text:
Anika Patel: Quick sync — trying to lock a 60m slot for a security/privacy review (threat model + access review + audit checklist) for the new routing service. Two options: Tue 2025-11-18 10:00 PT or Wed 2025-11-19 16:00 PT. Draft agenda below and pre-reads link: https://redwood.app/notes/routing-sec-prep (please add comments).

Anika Patel: Draft agenda:
```
1) 5m quick status + roll call
2) 20m threat model walkthrough (Samir) - assumptions, trust boundaries, attacker vectors
3) 15m access & secrets review (IAM roles, service accounts, KMS) - Alex
4) 10m audit readiness checklist (logs, retention, SSO evidence) - Jonathan
5) 10m open RFC/design review for fallback policy (PR #4021) + next steps
```

Jonathan Kim: Wed 16:00 PT works better for me. I have a 9:30 PT call on Tue.

Maya Chen: I can do Tue 10 if others prefer, but Wed is fine too.

Samir Gupta: Wed 16:00 PT ok for me. Also adding the threat model diagram to the doc — see section "attack-surface".

Alex Rivera: I will take the access piece. Planning to review IAM perms this afternoon and post a short summary. Also can run through what evidence we currently have for the audit checklist.

Anika Patel: Thanks. If Wed becomes the time, can folks please add any blockers to the pre-reads by EOD Tues? I want to circulate the final agenda + calendar invite by Wed morning.

Maya Chen: Quick Q — do we want Compliance on the invite or keep this engineering-only for the walkthrough and then invite Compliance for the audit checklist section?

Jonathan Kim: My preference: invite Compliance for the last 15 minutes only (audit checklist), so they can confirm evidence requirements. "Partial invite" is messy though — maybe invite them and ask to join at :50? Thoughts?

Anika Patel: Good call. I'll invite Compliance and note the suggested join time in the invite body.

Samir Gupta: One more ask — can the recorder flag for threat model changes after the meeting? I'll update the diagram but want someone to capture decisions (who, when).

Alex Rivera: I can take notes and push a follow-up with action items and owners. I'll include a short table: action, owner, due date.

security-bot: Calendar draft created: "Sec sync — Routing threat model & audit prep" Wed 2025-11-19 16:00 PT. Invite pending Anika confirmation. :calendar:

Anika Patel: Confirming Wed 2025-11-19 16:00 PT. Final agenda will be in the doc by 09:00 PT Wed. Please add any specific checklist items (logs, retention periods, SSO screenshots, KMS evidence) under the "audit-evidence" heading.

Jonathan Kim: I'll attach the last audit report excerpt and retention policy snippet to the doc by EOD today.

Maya Chen: :thumbsup: looking forward — thanks Anika.

Alex Rivera: Added my IAM notes to the doc, flagged a couple of role overlaps. Will bring mitigation suggestions to the meeting.

Samir Gupta: Diagram updated, left 2 TODOs for follow-up.

Anika Patel: Great — thanks everyone. If anything changes ping here; otherwise calendar invite will go out shortly and I'll post the final agenda link.

Maya Chen: Ack.
